name: Ava
description: An adult woman in her early thirties with fair freckled skin, an oval face, green eyes, softly arched eyebrows, a straight nose, and shoulder-length wavy auburn hair parted slightly off center. She wears an oatmeal crewneck sweater and has a warm, open expression.
voice_description: Warm, clear mid-register feminine voice with a neutral American accent and relaxed conversational delivery.
